title: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Game Reveals Collaborations With Godzilla, Evangelion in Video
content: Sega revealed at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday more upcoming collaborations for its Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game for its first year, in addition to two collaborations it will hold for the game's second year.
author: ANN

title: Sakamoto Days Creator’s Recommended Series Gets Its First Release
content: Thanks to the success of several long-running classics such as Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto, Bleach , etc., Weekly Shonen Jump became the best-selling manga magazine of all time. Launched in 1968, the magazine has serialized countless incredible manga series and one-shots over the decades.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia Unveils Trailer For an Upcoming New Project
content: My Hero Academia ‘s anime concluded the main story in its final season, but that’s not the end for the anime’s future yet. It’s been more than a week since the anime reached its conclusion, leaving fans with bittersweet feelings as the long journey comes to an end.

title: Palworld Game Reveals Version 1.0 Release on July 10 in Trailer
content: Pocketpair revealed during the Summer Games Fest event on Friday that its Palworld game will have its Version 1.0 release on July 10. The company also revealed the game's first cinematic trailer.
author: ANN

title: Sega, Ryu ga Gotoku Studio Reveal Virtua Fighter Crossroads Game in Trailer
content: Sega and its Ryu ga Gotoku Studio revealed the Virtua Fighter Crossroads game for a release in 2027 at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday. title: Fumito Ueda Reveals gen ATLAS Game
content: Fumito Ueda — game creator of such games as Ico , Shadow of the Colossus , and The Last Guardian — revealed his new game gen ATLAS at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Epic Games Store.
author: ANN

title: Koei Tecmo Reveals Attack on Titan 3 Game
content: Koei Tecmo Games and Omega Force revealed the Attack on Titan 3 game during the Summer Games Fest event on Friday. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Street Fighter 6 Game Reveals Yasmine, Arjun, Bosch, Final Fantasy VII's Tifa in Year 4
content: CAPCOM revealed the characters that will be available in Year 4 of its Street Fighter 6 fighting game. The new characters include Yasmine, Arjun, Bosch, and Final Fantasy VII's Tifa. English version Japanese version The game launched in June 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Square Enix Reveals Final Fantasy VII Revelation Game for Release in Spring 2027
content: Square Enix revealed at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday the Final Fantasy VII Revelation game. The game will launch simultaneously on all platforms ( PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PC via Steam and Epic Games Store) in spring 2027.
author: ANN
